name: docklock-plus
title: DockLock Plus
description: Move the macOS Dock between displays and choose where it can appear with DockLock Plus.
author: IGHOR

commands.name: set-dock-control-mode
commands.title: Set Dock Control Mode
commands.subtitle: DockLock Plus
commands.description: Choose Lock to Selected Displays, Dock Follows Mouse, or Off.

commands.name: move-dock-left
commands.title: Move Dock Left
commands.subtitle: DockLock Plus
commands.description: Move the Dock to the neighboring display on the left.

commands.name: move-dock-right
commands.title: Move Dock Right
commands.subtitle: DockLock Plus
commands.description: Move the Dock to the neighboring display on the right.

commands.name: move-dock-up
commands.title: Move Dock Up
commands.subtitle: DockLock Plus
commands.description: Move the Dock to the neighboring display above.

commands.name: move-dock-down
commands.title: Move Dock Down
commands.subtitle: DockLock Plus
commands.description: Move the Dock to the neighboring display below.

commands.name: move-dock-to-display-by-name
commands.title: Move Dock to Display by Name
commands.subtitle: DockLock Plus
commands.description: Choose a compatible display by name or number and request a Dock move.

commands.name: allow-dock-on-display
commands.title: Allow Dock on Display
commands.subtitle: DockLock Plus
commands.description: Allow the Dock on a compatible display in the current arrangement.

commands.name: disallow-dock-on-display
commands.title: Disallow Dock on Display
commands.subtitle: DockLock Plus
commands.description: Remove a display from the allowed displays in the current arrangement.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
